official_masks: Preserve exact released RL masks and node ordering; no resplit, seed split or role reassignment.
public_role_freeze: Read only info.yaml,features.csv,edgelist.csv,split_masks_RL.csv; freeze role IDs and file hashes before opening targets.csv.
unassigned_nodes: Preserve zero-membership official rows as unassigned; reject overlapping roles. Unassigned labels are never decoded by source-label stage.
effective_source_roles: official train/val roles intersect nonmissing source targets; compact packs preserve original feature-row indexing via frozen node-id mapping.
missing_target_parser: Draft custodian recognizes empty,nan,na,null,none strings; any other source token stops. Future source-role parsing/missingness parity against pinned provider is a mandatory gate; no silent vocabulary correction after results.
test_role: Official test IDs are public; no test missingness,class counts,labels,metrics or label-derived transforms before final admission.
custodian: A separate isolated acquisition process may CSV-tokenize targets while skipping all non-source rows before numeric conversion. It emits only train/val packs and their receipts.
worker_access: Worker namespace must exclude archive,raw targets,custodian memory,all test packs. Only public artifacts,frozen role IDs,compact train/val packs and admitted sources enter.
security: Authorization JSON is provenance, not access control. Actual isolation and denied worker paths require a reviewed gate before any source target read/output.
public_preprocessing: All public transductive features may fit native transforms; no test labels,missingness or targets may fit transforms. Known binary class count is fixed at two.
final_admission: Only after all phase attempts terminate and configs,selected checkpoints,pooling,controls,cost receipts are frozen, a separately admitted custodian may decode nonmissing official-test targets into an isolated report pack. Final labels select nothing.
